test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

It was a __Catch-22** **__situation for the manager.

options.text: A difficult situation in which the solution to a problem is impossible
A positive outcome in a tough situation

solution:
The correct answer is "**A difficult situation in which the solution to a problem is impossible**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "a dilemma or difficult circumstance from which there is no escape because of mutually conflicting or dependent conditions."
 
• We use the **given idiom to** refer to a situation where one is in a difficult circumstance and there are no easy escapes.
 
 
• ​**Example**:* When we discovered that the application we made had some glitches before a major launch, we were caught in a **Catch-22**__ situation.*
 
 

*​*Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
